summary: A new research paper titled “ ​AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance,”​ which was recently presented at the ​Conference on Language Modeling​ , has been attracting attention. It explores an obvious question: do AI tools negatively affect your ability to think?
takeaways: Here’s how ​a press release​ about the paper summarized these results: “The findings backed up what anecdotes and surveys have increasingly found in recent years: An overreliance on AI for answers erodes our cognitive fitness.
At first, the ChatGPT group performed better, which is not surprising because LLMs are good at solving math problems.
The high generated by side-stepping mental effort using LLMs is so compelling that, with only a short exposure, hard thinking quickly becomes intolerable.
